**[10-20 18:38 Beijing] Zhimingda signs RMB 49.275 million high-performance-computing-module supply contract**  
Zhimingda (智明达) announced signing a total-value RMB 49.275 million (incl. tax) product-purchase contract with Customer A1 for high-performance computing modules. Upon successful delivery, expected to positively impact FY 2026 operating results.  
_News · Tonghuashun · Zhimingda (智明达, 688636.SH) · [Source](https://news.10jqka.com.cn/20261020/c680894274.shtml)_

**[10-20 18:12 Beijing] Chiptronics Chengdu semiconductor packaging facility opens in High-tech Zone; 5-billion chip annual capacity**  
Chiptronics (日月新半导体, ATXGroup) Chengdu facility opened in Chengdu High-tech Zone. Registered capital RMB 300 million. Focus on mainstream IC packaging products: SOIC, QFN, LGA, FC. Expected annual capacity 5 billion chips. Chiptronics group is top-10 global semiconductor packaging and testing leader with five production bases in eastern coastal region. Chengdu facility marks company's pivot to western semiconductor market and key capacity layout expansion nationwide.  
_News · CLS · Chiptronics (日月新半导体, ATXGroup) · [Source](https://api3.cls.cn/share/article/2510059?os=web&sv=8.4.6&app=CailianpressWeb)_

**[10-20 18:00 Beijing] Xinlian Integrated Q3 2026 guidance: CPO/NPO silicon photonics deployment, MEMS OCS light switches in pilot production**  
Xinlian Integrated (芯联集成, 688469.SH) investor relations record: company disclosed differentiated advantages in CPO/NPO silicon photonics evolution: (1) complete layout of VCSEL, InP, silicon photonics, TFLN (thin-film lithium niobate), SiGe, MEMS OCS, covering optical chips, electronic chips, heterogeneous integration and optical switching modules; (2) rich TSV process mass-production experience supporting multiple integrated processes. On capacity: company owns 12-inch, 8-inch, 6-inch multi-size production lines with industry-leading MEMS production capacity. MEMS OCS light switches in small-batch pilot production. Phase-4 12-inch analog-mixed-signal production line reserves capacity for future optical chip volume. No significant financial figures disclosed.  
_News · Sina · Xinlian Integrated (芯联集成, 688469.SH) · [Source](https://finance.sina.cn/7x24/2026-10-20/detail-inivwiti7760114.d.html)_

**[10-20 17:39 Beijing] Richwave Technology Q3 2026 revenue RMB 212.7 million, up 42.5% YoY; net profit RMB 27.0 million, up 118.3%**  
Richwave Technology (富信科技, 688662.SH) Q3 2026: revenue RMB 212.7 million (up 42.5% YoY); net profit RMB 27.0 million (up 118.3% YoY). 9M 2026: revenue RMB 505.4 million (up 20.6% YoY); net profit RMB 49.1 million (up 50.0% YoY). Revenue growth mainly from increased sales of thermoelectric devices for high-speed optical modules. R&D investment RMB 23.4 million for 9M (down 10.9% YoY), representing 4.63% of revenue.  
_Filing · SSE/SZSE filing · Richwave Technology (富信科技, 688662.SH) · [Source](https://data.eastmoney.com/notices/detail/688662/AN202610201830720929.html)_

HKEX data shows JPMorgan Chase's holding in Cambridge Technologies H-shares rose from 5.26% to 10.26% on October 14, with average purchase price of HK$91.83.  
_News · CLS · Cambridge Technologies · [Source](https://api3.cls.cn/share/article/2509948?os=web&sv=8.4.6&app=CailianpressWeb)_

**[10-20 15:58 Beijing] Li Auto's MHX Technology raises RMB 1.625 billion, maintains Li Auto as controlling shareholder**  
Li Auto's chip and domain controller subsidiary MHX Technology is raising RMB 1.625 billion from external investors including Hangzhou Jingtao, Lanchi Ventures, Huaye Tiancheng and MiraclePlus. Li Auto will invest RMB 1 billion through a wholly-owned subsidiary to maintain controlling shareholder status and consolidate MHX Technology in financial statements. Bank of America Securities (BofA) sees the round as providing a unique platform to expand non-automotive opportunities and scale non-automotive business through external commercialization.  
_News · Sina · Li Auto · [Source](https://finance.sina.cn/7x24/2026-10-20/detail-inivwcmk0971085.d.html)_

**[10-20 14:56 Beijing] Citi cuts Lenovo price target from HK$50 to HK$40, maintains buy rating**  
Citi lowered Lenovo's price target, with Lenovo shares down as much as 9.8% intraday due to potential dilution from convertible bonds and warrants plus valuation updates. Analysts expect Lenovo to post "another solid quarterly result." Support factors include Infrastructure Solutions Group (ISG) continuing strong performance, Intelligent Devices Group (IDG) operating stably, and Solution Services Group (SSG) maintaining double-digit growth. Citi states: "Despite recent market concerns over high-leverage AI infrastructure companies causing AI supply-chain stock volatility, we believe Lenovo's direct exposure to high-risk new cloud customers remains limited." Target price cut 20% to HK$40 but maintains buy rating.  
_News · Xueqiu · Lenovo · [Source](http://xueqiu.com/5124430882/413029642)_

**[10-20 14:22 Beijing] China AI chip sector posts all-green Q3 results; Moore Threads rises 10%+**  
Domestic AI chip sector entered Q3 results disclosure window showing company-wide profit beats. Moore Threads (摩尔线程) rose 10%+; Aounce Tech, Yunzhi Lifei, Muxi, Chipyuan also advanced. Head domestic CPU/GPU makers including Haiguang Info, Longson Zhuke, Cambricon all posted positive profit guidance with net profit growth 50%+ to multiple times YoY.  
_News · CLS · Moore Threads (摩尔线程), Haiguang Info (海光信息), Longson Zhuke (龙芯中科), Cambricon (寒武纪) · [Source](https://api3.cls.cn/share/article/2509599?os=web&sv=8.4.6&app=CailianpressWeb)_

## Photonics & Optics (5)

🔴 **[10-20 17:54 Beijing] Lansi Semiconductor Q3 2026 net profit forecast RMB 1.2-1.3 billion, up 153.6-174.7% YoY; DDR5 chip shipments surge**  
Lansi Semiconductor (澜起科技, 688008.SH) guidance for Q3 2026: revenue approximately RMB 2,079 million (up ~46% YoY); net profit RMB 1,200-1,300 million (up 153.6%-174.7% YoY); non-GAAP net profit RMB 950-1,050 million (up 152.6%-179.2% YoY). Interconnection chip product line Q3 revenue estimated RMB 2,047 million (up ~49.3% YoY, up ~20.9% QoQ); gross margin 68.0%-68.5% (up 2.31-2.81 pp YoY, up 0.57-1.07 pp QoQ). Growth driven by increased AI inference and Agent application demand, surging server CPU needs and memory module/interconnect chip demand. DDR5 memory interface and module companion chip shipments significantly increased; DDR5 3rd, 4th and 5th generation RCD chip shipment share further improved, driving strong YoY earnings growth. Q4 2026 demand expected to increase further.  
_News · Tonghuashun · Lansi Semiconductor (澜起科技, 688008.SH) · [Source](https://news.10jqka.com.cn/20261020/c680892934.shtml)_

🔴 **[10-20 16:41 Beijing] Trigiant's subsidiary expected to win China Telecom outdoor optical fibre cable 2026-2027 procurement with RMB 10.9 billion bid**  
Trigiant Group's wholly-owned subsidiary Jiangsu Trigiant Technology Co., Ltd. ranked in top 30% as prospective successful bidder for China Telecom's centralised procurement of outdoor optical fibre cable 2026-2027, with bidding price including tax RMB 10,904,066,779.75. Procurement supports AI Data Centre (AIDC) infrastructure. Trigiant achieved historic growth in optical fibre and cable orders. Breakthrough driven by recent acquisition and integration of upstream optical preform production capacity, establishing end-to-end chain: optical preforms → optical fibres → cables. Qinghai Trigiant maintains stable 400-tonne optical preform capacity, expected to rapidly reach 1,000-tonne capacity near-term.  
_Filing · HKEX filing · Trigiant Group (01300) · [Source](https://www1.hkexnews.hk/listedco/listconews/sehk/2026/1020/2026102000436.pdf)_

🔴 **[10-20] Optical module demand surge drives supply chain; Innolight +65-82% profit, Optolink +142-162%**  
High-speed optical module demand growth transmits to supply chain. Innolight (光迅) Q1-Q3 net profit 11.89-13.1bn yuan (+65-82% YoY). Global AI capex drives datacenter optical module demand; domestic cloud builders expanding datacenters. Company leverages multi-scenario portfolio (datacenters, networks) for steady business growth. Optolink (光库, photonic components) Q1-Q3 net profit 2.79-3.02bn yuan (+142-162%). High-speed optical modules/components demand sustained; new products, client expansion, scale economy, cost reduction boost profitability. Tenjin Q3 revenue 300-320m yuan (+85-97%), net profit 44-48m yuan (+62-76%). Datacenter high-speed optical modules substrates boost orders, scale/product mix optimisation lift margins. Dajuji Laser H-series PCB demand rises significantly. 800G/1.6T high-speed modules substrate orders; verification/batch delivery underway. Market outlook: AI capex + speed upgrades expand opportunity; CPO/LPO tech evolution may coordinate optical chip/modulator upgrades; enterprises must maintain process yield, customer qualification, scale delivery to convert demand to results.  
_News · Caijing · Innolight (中际旭创), Optolink (光库科技), Tenjin (腾景科技), Dajuji Laser (大族激光) · [Source](http://stock.caijing.com.cn/20261020/5188712.shtml)_

**[10-20 16:13 Beijing] Pingan Electronics electronic cloth sees volume and price gains amid AI server, PCB demand**  
Pingan Electronics (in investor relations activity) reported that its electronic cloth products achieved both volume and price gains in the reporting period. High-frequency, high-speed PCB and AI server markets showed strong demand, with high-end electronic cloth in short supply, driving the company's electronic cloth sales revenue and gross margin to increase significantly.  
_News · EastMoney · Pingan Electronics · [Source](https://finance.eastmoney.com/a/202610203901322562.html)_

**[10-20 15:50 Beijing] Suzhou Longjie (603332.SH) Q3 2026 revenue up 48.2%, net profit up 189.3%**  
Suzhou Longjie Special Fiber (603332.SH) Q3 2026: Revenue RMB 658.6 million (+48.2% YoY). Net profit RMB 61.7 million (+189.3%). Nine-month 2026: Revenue RMB 1,566.7 million (+36.9%). Net profit RMB 1,163.4 million (+113.1%). The company benefited from improved industry supply-demand dynamics and expanding downstream demand. Product mix optimization and higher-end product penetration expanded product margins. The company makes differentiated specialty fibers: FDY, DTY, and POY products.  
_Filing · SSE/SZSE filing · Suzhou Longjie (603332.SH) · [Source](https://data.eastmoney.com/notices/detail/603332/AN202610201830715761.html)_

## Robotics (25)

🔴 **[10-20 21:01 Beijing] AgiBot deploys full-size humanoid robot in Wuhan retail warehouse**  
AgiBot (智元) partnered with Wuhan Wenlu Group and Zhongyun Weixun to build the world's first full-size dual-leg humanoid robot intelligent retail warehouse. AgiBot's Yuanzheng A3 Ultra robot deployed at Hankou Jiangtan 'Jiangyu' bridge cinema camp for real commercial operation as of 19 October 2026. The robot has run stably for 18 days, operating 8 hours daily matching customer traffic peaks; completed 827 cumulative orders with 97% pick success rate. Weekend peak traffic achieved over 100 orders daily with 100% success rate.  
_News · EastMoney · AgiBot (智元) · [Source](https://finance.eastmoney.com/a/202610203901539710.html)_

🔴 **[10-20] Neolix raises close to USD 400 million in Series E funding; cumulative fundraising exceeds USD 1 billion**  
On 20 October, Neolix announced completion of Series E funding round of approximately USD 400 million. Co-led by BOY Capital and a national-level fund, with participation from Alibaba AEF NextGen Hong Kong Fund, Monolith Capital, Guidepoint Capital, Temasek's Vertex Growth, China Film Capital, Guangqi Capital, Gold Tripod Capital, Longma Peak Ventures, Positive Robot, Leading Horizon, Gaogu Capital. Early and long-term shareholders Stone Venture, Xinchen Capital, Gaosei Investment, Cloud Rise Capital, SoftBank Asia continue participation. Gaogu Capital served as exclusive financial adviser. Neolix's cumulative fundraising now exceeds RMB 10 billion. Post-funding capital focus: (1) deepen refined operations network, accelerate localised service-hub layout in major global regions, build agile efficient global customer fulfilment network; (2) increase investment in end-to-end large-model data-training closed loop, further improve autonomous-driving safety level and vehicle performance, continuously lower vehicle life-cycle maintenance costs.  
_News · Caijing · Neolix (新石器) · [Source](http://tech.caijing.com.cn/20261020/5188691.shtml)_

- Physical AI 'training data' faces rigid supply constraints; real-world physical data collection logic differs completely from software AI data acquisition  
- Relevant companies have industry-exclusive positions  
- Process industries (beyond robotics) seen as priority landing area for physical AI applications, bridging AI decision-making and machine execution  
- This sector offers expectation gaps in physical AI supply chain; benefits from concurrent growth in compute demand at training and inference stages

Pre-bid contract value: RMB299.92 million. Public notice period ends October 23, 2026. As of announcement date, the project is at preferred-bidder public notice stage; Zhaoju Intelligent has not yet received formal notice of award. If successfully awarded, the project will help complete the company's embodied AI industry layout and enhance core competitiveness; uncertainty remains on contract execution.  
_News · Tonghuashun · Zhaofeng Holdings,300695.SZ · [Source](https://news.10jqka.com.cn/20261020/c680895810.shtml)_

## Power & Datacenter Infrastructure (14)

🔴 **[10-20 20:30 Beijing] Capitalonline (300846.SZ) launches fundraising for AIDC Phase II and intelligent computing centre projects**  
Capitalonline filed a prospectus for directed share issuance to raise capital for datacenter and intelligent computing infrastructure. The company reported 2026 H1 revenue of 665.17 million yuan; it is transitioning from traditional IDC and cloud services toward AI computing. Major risks include continuous losses (2023-2025: -340m, -303m, -170m yuan net profit), thin margins on cloud computing services, and intention orders not converting to formal contracts. AIDC Phase II targets 19.95% gross margin, 10.40% IRR; intelligent computing centre project targets 29.62% gross margin, 12.07% IRR. Company plans 128 high-performance GPU servers for the computing centre and has 384 units of intended rental orders, but these are non-binding. Risks include equipment supply constraints and price fluctuations from foreign sourcing, with potential impact if export controls tighten.  
_Filing · SSE/SZSE filing · Capitalonline (300846.SZ) · [Source](https://data.eastmoney.com/notices/detail/300846/AN202610201830725803.html)_

Revenue growth driven by business scale expansion.

🔴 **[10-20 19:27 Beijing] Ruijie Networks inventory surges 207% to RMB 9 billion, calls it 'strategic chip stockpiling'**  
Ruijie Networks (锐捷网络) reported Q3 2026 inventory up 207.32% from year-start to >RMB 9 billion.
